title: 230 Decibels in the Dark — The Sperm Whale

scenes.narration: Two kilometers off Dominica, the ocean floor drops into darkness. Something enormous rests at the surface, exhaling an angled plume of mist. Then its broad tail lifts clear of the waves. A sperm whale.
An adult male reaches eighteen meters long and weighs more than fifty tonnes. Its massive rectangular head makes up a third of its length, holding the largest brain of any animal on Earth.
scenes.beat_detail: Up to 50 tonnes · head is one-third of its body

scenes.narration: Inside that head sits a biological sonar cannon. Forcing air past nasal lips through oil-filled chambers, a sperm whale fires clicks reaching two hundred and thirty decibels, vibrating a diver's chest.
scenes.beat_detail: Measured at 230 dB re 1 μPa at 1 metre · loudest biological sound

scenes.narration: On a single breath, it dives two thousand meters into pitch darkness for ninety minutes, hunting giant squid by echo alone. Each family clan speaks its own dialect. Not blind in the dark. Built to see with sound.
scenes.opening_detail: Single-breath dive profile · spermaceti acoustics · Caribbean clan data
